# Rebuild the summary to test physical mbox recovery

The historical regression test inserts a message without a final newline between normal batches, checks the missing_eol counter, removes the summary file and reparses the store. It then checks the exact message-ID set and total count. A scoped storage-test recommendation is to include the rebuild step when the bug concerns physical message separation; a correct pre-existing database alone cannot establish that the bytes parse correctly. This task is absent at the fixed accepted endpoint, so it is historical test evidence rather than current executed coverage. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Mbox physical-store regression testing.
